product.name: SIJI Agent Graph
product.description: Structured AI-industry research over companies, products, positions, relationships, facts, evidence and changes.

relationship_semantics: Relationship codes and evidence states are returned together and should be preserved by clients.

onboarding.purpose: Use SIJI to explore AI-industry entities, relationships, facts, evidence and published changes.

broad_or_unknown_unknown.instruction: Read the visible industry map, identify relevant product layers and positions, then drill into the branches that matter.

known_company_or_product.instruction: Resolve the entity, reopen it, then follow its relationships, facts and evidence as needed.

broad_industry_discovery.goal: Map relevant product layers, companies, positions and recent changes before narrowing the research scope.

known_entity_deep_dive.goal: Research a known company, product or business.

commercial_stage_verification.goal: Verify sample, qualification, mass production, order, shipment, delivery or revenue claims.

multi_hop_propagation_and_compare.goal: Trace a change through the industry and compare explicit candidates.

interpretation_rules: Preserve the returned relationship type, evidence state and time scope.
Treat commercialization stages as separate facts when SIJI returns them separately.
Keep partial, unknown and conflict states explicit in downstream analysis.

use_web_for: latest events beyond the SIJI snapshot
information outside the current SIJI coverage
web_boundary.provenance_rule: Keep SIJI results and independently collected Web findings separately attributed.

references.entity: Reuse the typed entity references returned by SIJI in follow-up calls.
references.relationship: Reuse the full relationship_ref returned by SIJI when reopening an exact relationship.

operations.name: get_world_overview
operations.description: Read the current published industry map: companies, products/businesses, industry positions, typed relationships and category summaries.

WorldOverviewBudget.description: Fixed larger envelope for the one-shot lightweight world graph only.
WorldOverviewBudget.title: WorldOverviewBudget

input_schema.description: Return the current published industry map with lightweight typed relationships.
input_schema.title: WorldOverviewQuery

operations.name: search_entities
operations.description: Resolve names, aliases, tickers, product terms or industry positions to typed SIJI entity references.

operations.name: get_entities
operations.description: Open previously returned entity references and read their public identity and context.

operations.name: list_changes
operations.description: Read recent published changes or track an explicit set of entities with a checkpoint.

operations.name: expand_graph
operations.description: Explore relationships around returned entities, change direction, apply filters and reopen exact relationship references.

NodeFilter.description: Explicit filters; result filters and traversal filters are separate.
NodeFilter.title: NodeFilter

operations.name: trace_paths
operations.description: Find bounded paths between explicit entities or toward selected entity types, with optional waypoints and exclusions.

NodeFilter.description: Explicit filters; result filters and traversal filters are separate.
NodeFilter.title: NodeFilter

operations.name: get_facts
operations.description: Read qualified facts for explicit entities or reopen exact fact IDs with status, time, scope and citations.

operations.name: get_evidence
operations.description: Read evidence and source references behind facts or relationships, subject to source permissions.

operations.name: compare
operations.description: Align selected entities across the requested dimensions while preserving units, periods, evidence state and missing values.

interpretation: Use returned references for follow-up calls instead of reconstructing identifiers.
Keep evidence, coverage and conflict states attached to the facts or relationships they describe.
Use returned cursors unchanged when continuing a paginated result.
